title: The Bangkok map on a phone
kaylee: On her iPhone the Bangkok map now reads like Nan and Krabi: a river she can follow, little neighborhoods, a wheel that looks like a wheel, and the house and the mall big enough to spot.
questions: Asiatique's wheel now leans back so its face shows from above. Fun, or does it look broken?
The house moved one small step in from the board's west edge so its pin fits a phone held upright. OK?
Busy or calm: is the city about right now?

pictures.title: iPhone upright
pictures.caption: The river is never thinner than a river now, in stronger teal. Shophouses stand in 13 little streets (two market lanes) instead of dotted about. Towers line the skytrain. Wat Arun stands on a lawn. The house and ICONSIAM are bigger, and the board fills more of the screen.

pictures.title: iPhone sideways
pictures.caption: Same board, same camera as before when sideways. ICONSIAM, Asiatique, the flower market and Wat Arun each have a pier out into the river.

pictures.title: Nan, Bangkok, Krabi (upright, same phone)
pictures.caption: The house and the mall are now about as big on the screen as Nan's village and Krabi's elephant camp.
